build.provenance: Build TARGET from this committed source before running; this digest identifies measured delivered bytes, not a hosted build attestation.

scope: Synthetic data generated with actual application RevisionStore/StudioNotebook, built Jems UI, real Chromium localStorage/IndexedDB; desktop emulation on one shared Linux host. No network provider or cloud data. Native/notebook record operations use the actual selected authority. The legacyExport/legacyRestoreValidation key names retain comparison compatibility; indexed runs snapshot/restore the active indexed sources. They exclude originals, rewards, Pals and cloud; full backup is measured separately.
instrumentation: Synchronous JSON and localStorage instrumentation adds overhead; byte counters are UTF-16 code units, separately exported UTF-8 bytes. Startup includes browser navigation and readiness wait. IDB counters include logical JSON and binary payloads; footprint includes immutable history and retained original migration sources separately from localStorage, but omits browser index/page overhead. Original baseline v1 lacked these IDB counters and UI draft timing; compare v2 only. Process metrics are CDP observations of startup and the complete measured page lifetime (including explicit footprint traversal), not isolated CPU or physical-device memory. Samples share warm HTTP cache and accumulate one retained revision per sample.
